name: Reference source links are clickable anchor tags
description: The source URLs or titles in the References panel should be rendered as clickable anchor elements, not just plain text strings. Clicking a reference should attempt to navigate to the source.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match cell to open a match detail page

Verify that at least one entry in the References section is rendered as a clickable link (anchor tag) that shows a URL or underlined/highlighted text. Plain text that shows a URL but is not clickable fails this test.
